policy: Every unchecked Sendable or nonisolated(unsafe) declaration in owned production Swift requires a registry entry, explicit owner, synchronization invariant, review date, removal condition, deterministic evidence where applicable, and room within the no-unreviewed-growth budget.

unsafeDeclarations.invariant: The URLSession reference, the retained foreground configuration, and the shared serial delegate queue are assigned once during init and never mutated; sessions (including lazily created per-worker chunk sessions behind a Mutex) are invalidated only after terminal processing.
unsafeDeclarations.removalCondition: Remove these escapes when URLSession ownership can be expressed through immutable initialization without nonisolated storage or when the downloader is isolated behind one actor-compatible delegate boundary.

unsafeDeclarations.invariant: All reads and writes occur while the process-local lock is held.
unsafeDeclarations.removalCondition: Remove when the diagnostic handshake can be immutable after process launch or isolated in a concurrency-checked actor without synchronous call-site regressions.

unsafeDeclarations.invariant: The handshake override is a lock-protected one-way latch.
unsafeDeclarations.removalCondition: Remove when the one-way device-class handshake becomes an immutable launch value or moves behind a concurrency-checked isolation boundary.

unsafeDeclarations.invariant: The benchmark-only one-shot flag is read and written only while locked.
unsafeDeclarations.removalCondition: Remove when benchmark cold-start consumption is carried as request-local immutable state instead of a process-wide one-shot latch.

unsafeDeclarations.invariant: Verbosity is read and written only through the lock-protected property.
unsafeDeclarations.removalCondition: Remove when CLI verbosity is injected immutably into every command context and the process-wide compatibility accessor can be retired.

unsafeDeclarations.invariant: The observer token is assigned once during MainActor initialization and read only during deinitialization.
unsafeDeclarations.removalCondition: Remove when observer teardown can remain MainActor-isolated through an explicit lifecycle owner without deinitializer access to nonisolated storage.

entries.invariant: Ordinary access fails closed after open or migration failure; only explicit Retry serially replaces the failed state after a complete successful reopen.
entries.removalCondition: Remove unchecked conformance when GRDB storage ownership is fully actor-isolated or the database facade becomes a concurrency-checked immutable Sendable adapter.

entries.invariant: Ordinary access fails closed after open or migration failure; only explicit Retry serially replaces the failed state after a complete successful reopen.
entries.removalCondition: Remove unchecked conformance when the iOS GRDB storage owner is fully actor-isolated or the database facade becomes a concurrency-checked immutable Sendable adapter.

entries.owner: Qwen3 model generation gate and cache locks
entries.invariant: Mutable MLX values are accessed only by the single generation owner or their documented lock-protected cache.
entries.removalCondition: Remove each unchecked model/cache box when MLX arrays gain checked sendability or the corresponding value no longer crosses the single-owner generation boundary.

entries.invariant: The provider is retained for one converter invocation and callback mutation is serialized by AudioToolbox.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when AudioToolbox exposes a Sendable callback context or conversion input can be provided without a mutable cross-callback reference box.

entries.owner: EngineServiceHost actor and lock-protected request registries
entries.invariant: XPC callback boxes are single-resume and runtime access is serialized by the service actor.
entries.removalCondition: Remove unchecked types as XPC reply ownership and runtime context become expressible with checked Sendable values fully confined to the service actor.

entries.invariant: MLX arrays remain actor-confined and are never concurrently mutated outside the active generation owner.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when clone conditioning no longer carries MLXArray across the actor boundary or MLX provides checked Sendable immutable tensor handles.

entries.invariant: File operations and cancellation callbacks cross sendable closures through immutable or lock-protected boxes only.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when URLSession delegate callbacks can deliver file and cancellation state through checked Sendable values without mutable bridge boxes.

entries.invariant: Opaque MLX model and clone tensors remain behind the package facade; one generation task owns mutation through the loaded-model generation gate.
entries.removalCondition: Remove each facade escape when the opaque MLX model and clone tensors become checked Sendable or stop crossing package concurrency boundaries.

entries.invariant: The lock protects only the immutable first cancellation reason and one task-cancellation closure; it never guards MLX state, performs suspension, or remains held while invoking the closure.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when cancellation ingress can use a checked Sendable standard-library primitive while preserving synchronous first-reason capture and prompt task cancellation.

entries.owner: per-type locks or immutable capture boxes
entries.invariant: Each utility confines mutation to its documented lock, actor, queue, or immutable capture lifetime; the memory-pressure snapshot uses OSAllocatedUnfairLock for cross-domain reads while dispatch-source lifecycle stays queue-confined.
entries.removalCondition: Remove individual utility escapes as their framework callbacks and lock-protected state migrate to checked Sendable primitives without weakening synchronous diagnostics.

entries.owner: single active product output adapter and scratch-buffer lock
entries.invariant: The adapter drains one classified-session consumer and holds product finalization through atomic output and Fast QC; reusable PCM storage never escapes concurrent mutable access.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when product output and reusable PCM storage are fully confined to one checked isolation domain or use a standard Sendable buffer abstraction.

entries.owner: XPCNativeEngineClient main actor and single-resume pending request boxes
entries.invariant: Mutable client state stays main-actor isolated; callback bridges are single-resume and lock-protected.
entries.removalCondition: Remove as XPC callback APIs are wrapped by checked Sendable continuations and all client transport state remains expressibly MainActor-isolated.

entries.owner: framework callback lifetime plus lock, actor, or main-queue isolation
entries.invariant: Framework callbacks mutate only the registered synchronized state and are invalidated before owner teardown.
entries.removalCondition: Remove each callback bridge escape when the corresponding Apple framework offers checked Sendable callbacks or ownership can remain in one actor for its full lifetime.
